powers: merge accepted records after required review
restrictions: cannot independently elevate own contested scientific claim to independently-reviewed
must preserve dissent and corrections in public history

powers: curate a mission description and quest decomposition
restrictions: does not own the mission exclusively
must disclose material provenance and conflicts
must state scope, competence, and conflicts
review does not grant authority outside reviewed evidence class

decision_rules.publish_open_beta: Bootstrap maintainer may publish when the machine launch predicate passes.
decision_rules.accept_maintenance_artifact: Maintainer may merge after required automated checks and any specialist review named by the quest.
decision_rules.accept_scientific_artifact: Requires at least one independent competent reviewer plus all quest-specific checks; high-consequence claims may require multiple reviewers.
decision_rules.change_claim_to_independently_reviewed: Requires a public review record identifying reviewer scope and evidence.
decision_rules.mission_promotion: Seed missions are active-seed; community proposals enter public-rfc then active only after scope, source, and acceptance review.
decision_rules.appeal: Open a review or falsification record targeting the decision; a conflicted decision-maker may not be sole adjudicator of the appeal.
